library: Vital Signs trusted medical source library

approval.rule: Nothing is used by the AI until Vital Signs LLC approves it in writing. This file is only the first load; after it, an Admin adds, changes and approves sources through the API (/ai/admin/medical-sources).

link_check.method: Every link was opened and its title and year compared with the entry. Citations (DOI, journal, volume, pages, PMID) were checked against PubMed, PMC, the publisher page or the document itself.
link_check.rule: Only sources whose link and citation could be confirmed are included.

sources.authors: Pavía-López AA, Magaña-Serrano JA, Cigarroa-López JA, et al.
sources.title: Guía mexicana de práctica clínica para el diagnóstico y el tratamiento de la insuficiencia cardiaca

sources.patient_label: según las guías de la Sociedad Mexicana de Neumología y Cirugía de Tórax
sources.notes: Covers oxygen levels (SpO2 thresholds, including altitude). We found no SMNyCT guideline specifically on breathing rate; breathing rate for Mexico is covered by MX-OPS-BEC (OPS/OMS). Please confirm or suggest another SMNyCT document.
